Monday, 8:42. Pieter sees the same charge twice on his bank app. He writes in, in Dutch.
Deflekt reads the payments, the code, and yesterday's deploy.
It wasn't one customer. It was thirty eight. Four thousand two hundred euros.
And thirty seven of them haven't noticed yet.
Before anyone else writes in, the reply, the refunds and the fix are ready.
Lina, the developer on duty, watches the fix tested side by side. Nine lines. She approves it before her coffee gets cold.
Pieter gets his money back, and an apology in his own language.
And the next morning, management reads it in the brief: already solved, and remembered, so it never happens twice.
Deflekt. Every request your product gets, investigated and answered.
